patterns.note: A dark, deep blue-grey background is used consistently across the page, providing a high-contrast canvas for light text and vibrant accent colors.
Content is structured within a fixed-width container, centered horizontally, ensuring readability and visual consistency across various screen sizes.
Use of a distinct monospace font (Fira Code) for all code snippets, clearly differentiating them from other text and enhancing technical readability.
Strategic use of bright, almost neon, accent colors (green, yellow, orange) against a dark background to highlight keywords, data points, and interactive elements within complex diagrams.
Sections reveal themselves with a subtle fade-in or slide-up animation as they enter the viewport during scrolling, creating a dynamic and engaging experience.
Complex, multi-part illustrative diagrams are used extensively to explain product features and workflows, often integrating code snippets and data visualizations rather than simple screenshots.

technique_notes: A dark, deep blue-grey background is used consistently across the page, providing a high-contrast canvas for light text and vibrant accent colors.
Content is structured within a fixed-width container, centered horizontally, ensuring readability and visual consistency across various screen sizes.
Headings use a bold, modern sans-serif font for impact, while body text uses a highly readable sans-serif. Code examples are set in a distinct monospace font.

design_tokens.type_scale: Large, bold sans-serif headings (~3-4x body) with smaller, often uppercase, labels and a distinct monospace for code snippets.
design_tokens.radius: Subtle rounding on buttons and card-like elements, with some sharp edges for diagram components.
design_tokens.spacing: Balanced to airy, with generous vertical spacing between sections and within the hero, but tighter spacing within feature grids.

standout: The site's distinctive use of a dark, deep blue-grey background as a canvas for intricate, custom-designed data flow and UI illustrations is highly effective. These complex diagrams, often integrating vibrant accent colors and monospace code snippets, serve as the primary method for explaining the product's value, making the technical subject matter visually engaging and easy to digest.
